title: Copper Riot
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Copper Riot", at revision 1366217521, opens: "The Copper Coin Riot, also known as the Moscow Uprising of 1662 was a major riot in Moscow, which took place on 4 August [O.S. 25 July] 1662." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1968043, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs.
